content.content:
1	# Nexus Link Productions — Landing Page
2	
3	NexusLink landing and client research shell.
4	
5	## Stack
6	
7	- **Framework:** Next.js 14+ (TypeScript)
8	- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS + custom CSS
9	- **Hosting:** Ready for Vercel / self-hosted
10	
11	## Brand Compliance
12	
13	- **Background:** Dark (`#000000`, `#0A0A0A`, `#121212`)
14	- **Accent:** Crimson (`#DC143C`), used sparingly
15	- **Typography:** Clean, modern sans-serif, high-contrast hierarchy
16	- **Aesthetic:** Premium · Futuristic · Minimal
17	
18	## Routes
19	
20	- `/` - public NexusLink landing module
21	- `/research` - client research workspace
22	- `/sources` - design radar reference shelf
23	
24	## Structure
25	
26	```
27	src/
28	├── app/
29	│   ├── layout.tsx       (root layout)
30	│   ├── page.tsx         (home)
31	│   ├── research/
32	│   │   └── page.tsx     (client research workspace)
33	│   ├── sources/
34	│   │   └── page.tsx     (design radar)
35	│   └── globals.css      (global styles)
36	├── components/
37	│   ├── Header.tsx       (navigation + logo)
38	│   ├── Hero.tsx         (main hero section)
39	│   ├── Services.tsx     (services grid)
40	│   ├── Portfolio.tsx    (work showcase)
41	│   ├── Contact.tsx      (contact section)
42	│   └── Footer.tsx       (footer)
43	public/
44	├── logos/               (LOGO INTEGRATION HERE)
45	├── images/              (portfolio / hero images)
46	└── videos/              (hero reel video)
47	```
48	
49	## Setup
50	
51	```bash
52	# Install dependencies
53	npm install
54	
55	# Run dev server
56	npm run dev
57	
58	# Build for production
59	npm build
60	
61	# Start production server
62	npm start
63	
64	# Smoke-check the built routes
65	npm run smoke
66	```
67	
68	Server runs on `http://localhost:3000` by default.
69	
70	## Next Steps
71	
72	1. **Logo Integration:**
73	   - Add logo files to `public/logos/`
74	   - Update Header.tsx with actual logo (replace placeholder)
75	
76	2. **Content Integration:**
77	   - Tune the landing copy to match the final brief
78	   - Add real research content to `/research`
79	   - Populate `/sources` with the canonical reference notes
80	
81	3. **Forms & Interactivity:**
82	   - Wire up contact form (email service integration)
83	   - Add analytics (GA, Posthog, etc.)
84	   - Add scroll animations if needed
85	
86	4. **Deployment:**
87	   - Deploy to Vercel (native Next.js support)
88	   - Configure custom domain
89	   - Set up SSL/TLS
90	
91	## Customization
92	
93	All colors are defined in `tailwind.config.ts` and `src/app/globals.css`. Update the `colors` object in the Tailwind config to modify the brand palette.
94	
95	Brand standards live in `/Volumes/T7/.claude/rules/brand-standards.md`.
